newsitem.title: USA: Delchamps Inc enters merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Delchamps Inc enters merger talks.

text.p: Delchamps Inc said its financial adviser Credit Suisse First Boston has identified a limited number of potential buyers who have expressed an interest in purchasing the company.
Delchamps said a previous statement denying that it was engaged in merger talks was incorrect and issued by an employee who was not aware of the recent discussions.
Company chairman David Morrow said however that Delchamps has not yet reached an agreement with anyone and cautioned that there is no assurance that a deal will be completed.
Morrow said the supermarket operator will have no further comment until the matter is concluded.
Delchamps was up 1/2 at 31-1/4 early Monday.
